name: Militech M-31a1 Advanced Infantry Combat Weapon

system.flavor: An over-and-under 4.5mm liquid-propellant assault weapon atop a pump-action mini grenade launcher. A propellant and oxidizer are mixed in the firing chamber and electrically fired, launching a 50-grain copper-jacketed bullet and cycling the action.
system.notes:
Chromebook 1 p.45 (PDF idx 46) text layer, cross-checked against a fresh tesseract pass over the page image: RIF 2 N R 4D6 (4.5mm) 150 30 ST/VR, 1695eb. Chromebook 1's table prints no range column; the reliability cell is printed as two values (ST/VR) for the rifle and the underslung launcher.

Range and the mini-grenade launcher block from Blackhand's Street Weapons p.28 (PDF idx 29), citing [Chromebook 1]: RIF +2 N R 4D6 (4.5MM) 150 3/30 ST 400M, plus MGL -1 VARIES (25MM MINI-GREN) 4 ... The magazine holds 150 projectiles plus the liquid propellant to fire them.
